question: The National Conference on Good Governance, organised by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) was held in which of the following places in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhinagar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Conference on Good Governance** was organized by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)** in **January 2025**.
 
• The conference aimed to promote **effective governance practices** and foster transparency, accountability, and citizen-centric administration.
 
• **Gandhinagar**, the capital city of **Gujarat**, was chosen as the venue for this significant event.
 
• The conference witnessed participation from **government officials, policy experts, and representatives** from various states to share best practices and innovations in governance.
 
• The event focused on discussions related to **digital transformation in public administration, grievance redressal mechanisms, and citizen engagement strategies**.
